aboutH2: Aurora Recovery Centre’s Holistic Approach to Addiction Recovery
intro: Aurora Recovery Centre is different from other addiction recovery centers in that it focuses on the biological, physical, spiritual, and psychological well-being of its clients. This holistic approach means that they consider all aspects of an individual’s life when designing their treatment plan, from diet and exercise to emotional and spiritual well-being.

One of the key components of their approach is personalized care: they tailor each treatment plan to the individual’s unique needs and preferences, ensuring that they receive the best possible care. Aurora’s experienced staff is comprised of medical, therapeutic, and clinical specialists who are dedicated to bringing wellness to individuals and families suffering from the effects of addiction.

The strengths-based perspective used at Aurora Recovery Centre means that all therapeutic groups, individual counselling sessions, and psycho-educational components are presented from the perspective of building on an individual’s existing assets. This approach helps clients to build self-esteem, confidence, and resilience, all of which are important factors in long-term recovery.

pillars.title: Aurora Recovery Centre’s Location
pillars.body: Located in Gimli, Manitoba, and just one hour north of Winnipeg, Aurora Recovery Centre offers a welcoming, respectful, and professional environment for addiction and mental health treatment. The center is situated on beautiful grounds, which include walking paths, gardens, and other outdoor spaces for clients to enjoy. The location of Aurora Recovery Centre offers clients a peaceful and serene setting in which to recover. Away from the pressures and stresses of daily life, clients can focus solely on their recovery and well-being. The center’s proximity to Winnipeg also ensures that clients have access to a wide range of amenities and resources, such as medical facilities, shopping, and entertainment.

pillars.title: The Recovery Management System at Aurora Recovery Centre
pillars.body: Aurora Recovery Centre offers a comprehensive recovery management system that supports clients throughout the entire recovery process, from assessment to ongoing recovery management for life. This system ensures that clients receive the care and support they need not just during their time at the center, but also after they leave. The recovery management system includes an assessment process to determine the client’s unique needs and preferences, which is used to create a tailored treatment plan. Clients then receive inpatient care, which may include detox, therapy, and medication management. Once they leave the center, they have access to continuing care, which includes regular check-ins, support groups, and other resources to help them maintain their sobriety. The dedicated team at Aurora Recovery Centre plays a critical role in the recovery management system. They offer ongoing support and guidance, helping clients navigate the challenges of recovery and providing resources to help them succeed.

pillars.title: One Counsellor, a Full Team and Staff Who Know Recovery
pillars.body: Everyone who comes to Aurora is paired with one counsellor, who stays with them for the whole residential stay. That counsellor works alongside clinical and addiction counsellors, therapists, nurse practitioners and nurses, client care specialists, a personal trainer and a family program director. The centre says many of its staff are in long-term recovery themselves. Aurora sits in Treaty 1 Territory on the west shore of Lake Winnipeg, and Indigenous practice is part of ordinary life here. Smudging happens daily, sweat lodges and sacred fires run weekly, and people who finish the program are marked with a gratitude ceremony.

overview: Aurora Recovery Centre, nestled in the serene town of Gimli, MB, is a top-of-the-line private rehab center. The facility has earned a reputation for providing unparalleled care to individuals struggling with substance abuse and co-occurring disorders. Aurora Recovery Centre offers a comprehensive range of services, from residential treatment and detox to family outpatient programs and interventions. The center’s experienced and compassionate staff strives to provide each patient with personalized care that supports long-term recovery.

At Aurora Recovery Centre, patients have access to amenities and activities that promote wellness and healing. The rehab facility is situated in a picturesque setting that offers patients a sense of peace and tranquility. The air-conditioned facility has comfortable bedrooms, a spacious dining hall, and common areas for various recreational activities such as fitness centers, yoga and meditation rooms, and art and nature therapy. Patients can also benefit from a range of evidence-based practices, individual therapy and counseling, family therapy and counseling, group therapy and counseling, and nutritional counseling to help them overcome the underlying causes of their addiction. The center also offers holistic therapy approaches that promote mind, body, and spirit connection, providing patients with a complete road to recovery.

location.heading: Aurora Recovery Centre in Gimli, Manitoba
location.intro: Aurora Recovery Centre is on Lakeside Road just north of Gimli, on the west shore of Lake Winnipeg in Manitoba's Interlake. Winnipeg is about an hour south by Highway 8 or 9, Selkirk is around 40 minutes away, Portage la Prairie close to 2 hours and Brandon about 3 hours, and people come from across the Prairies and the rest of Canada.

cells.v: Ongoing intakes, usually within 1 to 10 days

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Aurora Recovery Centre cost?
faqs.a: Aurora publishes its prices: $19,900 for 30 days, $26,900 for 45 days, $33,900 for 60 days and $44,900 for 90 days, in Canadian dollars. Its FAQ also lists daily rates of $1,000 for detox and $675 for primary treatment, and says detox is included in the cost of treatment. Massage, reiki and prescription medication are extra.

faqs.q: How long is treatment at Aurora?
faqs.a: The average stay is 45 days. Aurora offers 30, 45, 60 and 90 day programs and recommends a length after a confidential phone assessment. People who need more time can step down into transitional housing on the property through the Extended Care Program.

faqs.q: Does Aurora Recovery Centre offer detox?
faqs.a: Yes. Aurora has a 24/7 medical detox unit on site, run by nurse practitioners and nurses, and says it is the only private treatment centre in Manitoba with one. Everyone spends at least 24 hours there on arrival, and detox usually lasts three to seven days.

faqs.q: How do I get to Aurora from Winnipeg?
faqs.a: The centre is about an hour's drive north of Winnipeg, at 20025 Lakeside Road just past Gimli on Lake Winnipeg. Selkirk is around 40 minutes away. The website does not list transport options, so ask admissions at (204) 642-8058 or 1-844-515-7867 to plan your arrival.

You go home with a personal continuing care plan and lifetime access to Aurora's continuing care, which the centre says is free under its Recovery for Life program. That covers weekly alumni groups, a private alumni Facebook group and help connecting with 12-Step or other peer support. Transitional housing on the property is available through the Extended Care Program.

faqs.q: Is Aurora private? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, Aurora is a private-pay centre. Its website does not mention billing insurers directly, so ask admissions what paperwork your benefits plan needs. Financing up to $40,000 is available through iFinance Medical (Medicard), with terms of 12 to 72 months.

faqs.q: Does Aurora offer outpatient or virtual treatment?
faqs.a: Yes. Its Intensive Outpatient Program, run by ARC Counselling, is delivered over Zoom in groups of up to 10, with group therapy and eight one-to-one sessions. You need to be fully detoxed or on a managed taper first. ARC Counselling is at (204) 202-1221.

faqs.q: Can my family visit or take part?
faqs.a: Yes. Aurora has weekly family visiting hours, and other times can be arranged with your counsellor's approval. ARC Counselling also runs a 6-week Family Program on Wednesday evenings from 6 to 8 pm Central, covering topics like enabling, boundaries, grief and self-care.

faqs.q: What distinguishes Aurora Recovery Centre from other addiction recovery centers?
faqs.a: Aurora Recovery Centre focuses on the biological, physical, spiritual, and psychological well-being of its clients, using a personalized, holistic approach to recovery that tailors treatment to each individual.

faqs.q: What kind of therapeutic modalities does Aurora Recovery Centre offer?
faqs.a: Aurora Recovery Centre offers evidence-based modalities, including individual counseling, group therapy, psycho-educational sessions, and specialized programs such as trauma therapy.

faqs.q: How does Aurora Recovery Centre approach recovery management?
faqs.a: Aurora Recovery Centre’s recovery management system supports clients throughout the entire recovery process, from assessment to ongoing recovery management for life, providing regular support and resources to help clients maintain their sobriety.

faqs.q: What is the strengths-based perspective used at Aurora Recovery Centre?
faqs.a: The strengths-based perspective means that all therapeutic groups, individual counseling sessions, and psycho-educational components are presented from the perspective of building on an individual’s existing assets, helping clients to build self-esteem, confidence, and resilience.

faqs.q: What kind of staff does Aurora Recovery Centre employ?
faqs.a: Aurora Recovery Centre’s staff includes experienced and credentialed medical, therapeutic and clinical specialists who are dedicated to bringing wellness to individuals, families and institutions suffering from the effects of addiction.
